exec_summary: Site traffic (GA4, 2026-05-30 to 2026-06-05): growthbook.io had 14,495 sessions and 10,418 users (+28.0% week over week).

**Site performance**
- **Overall (GA4, all traffic):** 14,495 sessions (+28.0% WoW) | 10,418 users
- **Overall (GSC, organic search):** 3,171 clicks (-6.8% WoW) | 157,227 impressions (-32.8% WoW)
- **Homepage (/):** 8,485 GA4 sessions (+8.4% WoW) all-traffic | 1,756 GSC clicks (-4.3% WoW) organic | 16,183 GSC impressions (-13.3% WoW)
- **Pricing (/pricing):** 1,378 GA4 sessions (+15.1% WoW) all-traffic | 93 GSC clicks (-13.9% WoW) organic | 4,745 GSC impressions (-19.4% WoW)
- **Docs (docs.growthbook.io):** 4,453 GA4 sessions (-16.0% WoW) all-traffic | 1,036 GSC clicks (-11.9% WoW) organic | 108,303 GSC impressions (-9.9% WoW)
- **All other pages:** 7,756 GA4 sessions (+61.4% WoW) all-traffic | 269 GSC clicks (-13.2% WoW) organic | 109,468 GSC impressions (-37.1% WoW)
- Pricing and all-other-pages GA4 all-traffic is up sharply while GSC organic clicks are down on both -- consistent with AI assistants sending traffic that GSC doesn't capture. Worth monitoring for another week before acting, but the pattern is repeating.
- Docs GA4 sessions down -16.0% WoW after last week's +10.2% -- a reversal worth watching.

**New competitor activity**
- **LaunchDarkly** published **"AI Experimentation"** (KD 52, Tier 1) and **"Run Experiments"** solution page -- two coordinated assets reinforcing their experiment-governance narrative. Combined with last week's runtime page surge, LD is building multi-channel authority across AI experimentation and runtime control simultaneously.
- **LaunchDarkly** published **"AI SDKs 1.0"** changelog and **"Feature Flags vs Feature Branching"** blog -- AI SDK release signals product investment in developer tooling that directly overlaps GrowthBook's open-source ICP.
- **LaunchDarkly** server-side SDKs docs page (**launchdarkly.com/docs/sdk/server-side**) hit 76 ETV with +177.3% WoW surge -- the largest ETV mover this week. Signals Google rapidly rewarding LD's SDK documentation depth.
- **Harness** published **"Feature Flag Tools Compared: 10 Best Platforms for Safer Releases"** -- a direct comparison post that will rank on queries where GrowthBook's **/blog/best-open-source-feature-flagging-tools-compared** is competing for the same intent. Harness now has a comparison post; GrowthBook's equivalent has zero impressions yet.
- **PostHog** published **"LLM Prompt Experiments"** and **"Prompt Experiments"** docs -- two new pages targeting AI/LLM experimentation workflows, an area GrowthBook has not yet addressed with dedicated content. PostHog is moving fast on AI-native experimentation.
- **Optimizely** "Powering AI With Feature Flags" continues to appear (carried over from prior weeks) -- flagged again because GrowthBook's **/solutions/ai** page remains at 0 clicks and no counter-content has shipped.

**New GrowthBook content**
- Ten pages detected via sitemap this week (real publish dates unknown). None have GSC impressions yet -- still indexing. Highest-potential:
  - **/blog/best-open-source-feature-flagging-tools-compared** -- already earning 18 clicks/week (up from 9 last week), the fastest mover in the gains list. Compete directly with Harness's new comparison post.
  - **/blog/a-practitioners-guide-to-treatment-effects-in-experimentation-ate-cate-itt-late-att-explained** -- high-authority stats content; relevant to the same audience PostHog is targeting with CUPED docs.
  - **/blog/12-common-feature-flag-mistakes-to-avoid** -- broad developer audience, competes with Harness/Optimizely "mistakes" content.
  - **/blog/chasing-velocity-in-a-b-testing-why-more-experiments-can-mean-less-learning** and **/blog/experimentation-program-mistakes-to-avoid** -- thought leadership assets with no direct equivalent from competitors this week.

**Organic movers worth watching**
- **/blog/best-open-source-feature-flagging-tools-compared** jumped from 9 to 18 clicks (+9) -- the top organic gainer this week excluding the homepage. A Harness comparison post now targets the same queries; promote this page before Harness's version ages in.
- **/blog/a-b-testing-in-the-age-of-ai** up from 8 to 15 clicks (+7) -- AI-angle content is gaining traction organically. Reinforces the case for dedicated AI experimentation pages.
- **/insights/status-code-what-means-how-fix** dropped from 20 to 0 clicks (-20) and **/insights/matched-pairs-design-explained** dropped from 10 to 1 click (-9) -- both were flagged as ETV surgers last week. Likely a correction after last week's baseline anomaly; monitor next week.
- **"launchdarkly business model b2b"** still at position 10.25 with 1,681 impressions -- fifth consecutive week flagged, no title-tag action taken on **/compare/growthbook-vs-launchdarkly**. Clicks on that page are only 5 this week despite 4,086 impressions over 28 days.
- **Comparison pages** back to 13 total 7-day views (within normal 12-20 range, recovering from two consecutive weeks below floor). **/compare/growthbook-vs-statsig** up to 3 clicks from 1 -- small positive move.
- **"experimentation platform"** not in striking distance list this week -- likely drifted further from page 2 (was position 16.79 last week). Cannot confirm without direct check.

**Recommended actions**
- **Refresh **/compare/growthbook-vs-launchdarkly** title and H1 for "launchdarkly business model b2b" this week.** Position 10.25, 1,681 impressions, 5 clicks -- five consecutive weeks flagged with no action. This is the single easiest lever available.
- **Promote **/blog/best-open-source-feature-flagging-tools-compared** before Harness's equivalent ages in.** GrowthBook's page is already earning clicks (18 this week); Harness just published a direct competitor post. Internal links and social promotion now maximizes the head start.
- **Publish a dedicated LLM/AI experimentation page or blog post.** PostHog shipped two prompt-experiment docs this week; LaunchDarkly published "AI Experimentation" (KD 52). GrowthBook's **/solutions/ai** is at 0 clicks. A targeted post on "A/B testing LLM prompts" or "feature flags for AI models" directly intercepts this fast-moving keyword cluster.
- **Investigate Docs GA4 decline (-16.0% WoW).** Last week docs was the one bright spot (+10.2%). A -16% reversal in one week warrants a quick check -- confirm it is not a tagging issue or a broken link before treating as an engagement signal.

**Data quality flags**
- GSC page-split window (2026-05-25 to 2026-05-31) is one week behind the GA4 window (2026-05-30 to 2026-06-05) -- slight date mismatch between sources, normal API lag.
- ETV WoW percentages remain unreliable through 2026-05-24 per the pipeline note; the LD server-side SDK +177.3% surge should be treated as directional only.
